t: Shello lebashshel letzorek nokri beyom tob
s: Shello lebashshel letzorek nokri beyom tob ubo z' seipim. Kol melakot "okel nepesh" lo hutteru ella letzorek akilat yisrael, abal lo letzorek akilat nokri velo letzorek akilat behema, shenneemar "hu lebaddo yeaseh lakem" —"lakem" velo lenokrim, "lakem" velo libhema. Lepikak asur lezammen nokri sheyyabo etzlo leekol bebeto, gezera shemma yarbeh lebashshel od qedera acheret bishbil hannokri. Abal muttar lishloach lo maakal lebeto, dekevan sheeno mazmino lebeto — en chosheshin shemma yarbeh bishbilo. Raq sheyyizzaher shello yishlach lo derek reshut harabbim apillu sholeach lo al yede nokri, deasur lehotzi mereshut lirshut bishbil nokri, vekol sheasur laasoto — asur lomar lenokri laasoto. Abal muttar lishloach lo al yede nokri derek karmelit, shello gazeru al shebut dishbut shel issur hotzaa beyom tob, shehare im yesh bah tzorek yom tob qetzat — muttar laasotah al yede yisrael.

Veken nokri shebba meelayv lebet hayyisrael shello hizmino kelal, veken shaliach shennishtallach elayv — muttar lehaakilo immo, veen chosheshin shemma yarbeh bishbilo ella keshemmazmino lebeto, shehu rotzeh lekabbedo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehayyisrael noten lo leekol beli shum hazmana vehaptzara, abal asur lehaptzir bo sheyyokal etzlo, apillu kebar bishshel vetiqqen kol tzorke seuddato, dekevan shehu maptzir bo verotzeh lekabbedo — yesh lachush shemma yebashshel od qedera acheret bishbilo.

Ap al pi shemmuttar lehosip basar biqdera letzorek hachol veal derek shennitbaer besimman tq"g, mikkol maqom letzorek hannokri asur lehosip kelum, ap al pi sheeno mazmino shemmuttar lehaakilo immo ukemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu rotzeh lekabbedo umosip basar bishbilo — yesh lachush shemma yebashshel bishbilo od qedera acheret, venimtza oseh melaka beyom tob bishbil hannokri bilbad. Abal muttar lehosip basar bishbil abdo veshipchato o bishbil kalbo biqdera shemmebashshel bah letzorek yom tob, dekevan sheeno noten lahem leekol bishbil kebodam ella mechamat shemmezonotam alayv — en lachush shemma yebashshel od qedera acheret bishbilam, kevan sheeno rotzeh litten lahem basar yoter mimmah shemmosip bishbilam.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmosip basar biqdera qodem shennetanah etzel haesh, denimtza shekkol meleket habbishshul, dehaynu netinat habbasar etzel haesh, naasa bebat achat, veeno mosip shum melaka bishbilan, abal leachar shennatan haqqedera etzel haesh — asur lehosip bah basar bishbil abdo veshipchato o bishbil kalbo, ap al pi shelletzorek hachol muttar lehosip basar biqdera apillu leachar shennetanah etzel haesh (veal derek shennitbaer besimman tq"g), lepi shehattabshil hu yoter mishtabbeach umitettaqqen kesheyyesh harbeh basar baqqedera, venimtza shekkol habbasar shebbaqqedera hu letzorek yom tob, mikkol maqom hetter zeh eno moil ella im ken yakol leekol kol habbasar beyom tob im yirtzeh, abal kan sheeno yakol leekol kol habbasar beyom tob im yirtzeh, shehare tzarik litten miqtzato leabdo veshipchato vekalbo shemmezonotayv alayv — en hetter zeh moil kelum, mittaam shennitbaer besimman tq"v. Lepikak im yesh lo maakalim acherim sheyyukal litten leabdo veshipchato o lipne kalbo — muttar lehosip bishbilam basar baqqedera shemmebashshel letzorek yom tob, veken muttar leepot bishbilam pat battannur sheapa bo letzorko. Veap al pi sheoseh melaka bishbilam, shehare kol pat upat tzarik tircha bipne atzmo, mikkol maqom, kevan shekkol happat rauy lo, shehare yesh lo maakalim acherim litten lipnehem, vegam happat sheyyokal beyom tob hu mishtabbeach umitettaqqen al yede apiyya zo sheopeh bishbilam, shehappat neepeh yapeh bizman sheyyesh harbeh pat battannur — nimtza shekkol haapiyya hi tzorek yom tob.

Yisrael haopeh betannuro shel nokri vetzarik latet lehannokri bead sekar hattannur — lo yeyached lo pat echad qodem haapiyya, deaz nimtza shehu opeh pat shel nokri, ella yopeh kol happat bistam, veachar kak yitten lo pat echad biskar tannuro.

Bene hachayil shennatenu qemach shellahem leyisrael leepot lahem pat, im enan maqpidin keshehayyisrael noten pat echad lattinoq mehappat sheapa lahem — muttar leepot lahem beyom tob al yede sheyyitten pat echad mehem lattinoq, shehare im lo yopeh lahem kol happat lo yannichu litten lattinoq, kevan shekkol haqqemach hu shellahem — nimtza shekkol haapiyya hi letzorek akilat hattinoq. Veken im apillu hayyisrael noten lahem haqqemach mechoq hammalkut, ella sheen hayyisrael rashshay leepot miqqemach pat echad lattinoq ella im ken yopeh lahem kol happat — muttar leepot lahem beyom tob al yede sheyyitten pat echad mehem lattinoq. Veap al pi shezzo hi haarama, shehare eno noten happat lattinoq ella kede lehattir lo leepot beyom tob, ukebar nitbaer besimman tq"z sheasur lehaarim baapiyyat happat, mikkol maqom mechamat haddechaq hittiru lo lehaarim, sheqqasheh lehippater mibbene hachayil sheyyesh chiyyub mechoq hammalkut leepot lahem, ulepikak hittiru lehaarim apillu leachar shekkebar akelu seuddat yom tob (ayyen simman tq"g), veen lilmod mikkan lishar meqomot.

Muttar letaltel mezonot sheenan reuyin ella libhema apillu en lo behema bebeto. Veim yesh lo — muttar litroach velitten lepaneha mezonot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"d leinyan shabbat. Ubilbad sheyyizzaher shello yaaseh shum melaka bishbilah, apillu shebut shel dibrehem, kegon lehotzi mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit vekayyotze bazeh. Lepikak, asur legabbel et hammursan ki im al yede shinnuy, al derek shennitbaer besimman shk"d leinyan shabbat.
